name: NuGet pack tooling
tagline: Discover, build, and pack Lyo.* packages with git change detection.
description: SDK-style `dotnet pack` for libraries under Lyo.Net. Fingerprints each project directory so unchanged packages are skipped. Refreshes tooling READMEs via tooling-docs before packing.

commands.blurb: Pack all packages at a specific version
Pack one package and its Lyo ProjectReference deps

notes: NUGET_OUTPUT_DIR defaults to ~/nuget-local; state file is $NUGET_OUTPUT_DIR/.build-state
Directory.Build.targets runs tooling-docs on Pack when python3 is available
